messages:
incident-bot: PAGING @alex_oncall — embeddings-prod (us-east1) inflight queue > 95th pct and tail latency spiking. dashboards: https://redwood.internal/d/embeddings-prod
alex_oncall: seeing it, joining.
lee_runtime: I can already see long-running KV cache misses and > 120s decode tasks piling on the embed route.
jordan_sre: symptoms: steady qdepth growth, timeout spikes, some 503s. Impact: ~8% of requests getting 504s for tenants with heavy batch windows.
maya_prod: any known customer impact? Support queue is getting pings from large-tenant A and B.
samir_support: Customer A reporting slow bulk embeddings and partial failures. They're on dedicated capacity but hit a burst window.
alex_oncall: initial plan: 1) soft-per-tenant quota cut on heavy tenants 2) lower max-inflight for /v1/embeddings route 3) temporarily disable nonessential background rerank jobs that hit same pool
lee_runtime: I'll run the ratecap update and max-inflight immediately.
lee_runtime: running:
```
adminctl patch /services/embeddings --set "routes.v1.embedding.max_inflight=8"
adminctl patch /quotas --match tenant=A --set "burst_multiplier=0.7"
```
ops-bot: Applied config change: routes.v1.embedding.max_inflight = 8 (propagated to 6/8 hosts). Rolling update in progress.
alex_oncall: also throttling tenant B via per-minute cap: set to 60r/min
jordan_sre: pushing soft-shed policy for long-queue requests (age > 6s) to return 429 with Retry-After. This reduces tail.
lee_runtime: enabled age-shed rule. snippet:
```
backpressure:
  - route: /v1/embeddings
    age_threshold_s: 6
    action: soft_shed
```
maya_prod: communicating to customers: messaging draft ready — short note about "temporary throttles to protect platform stability". Ready to send once we confirm metrics improving.
samir_support: queued that outbound note for Customer A, mention reduced throughput window and suggested retry backoff.
alex_oncall: metrics check — 10m after changes: inflight down ~35%, 95th latency down ~40%, 503 rate dropped to baseline.
lee_runtime: noticed a small spike in decode errors after lowering max_inflight on a subset of hosts; rolling back that host's runtime to previous kernel.
ops-bot: Kernel rollback completed on host gpu-12; decode errors subsided.
jordan_sre: follow-up tuning: increase request timeout for embedding decode from 120s -> 160s for isolated hosts to let stragglers finish rather than shed immediately. Will monitor latency.
alex_oncall: good. Product, let's keep rerank disabled for 30m, then staged enable if stable.
maya_prod: agreed. I'll pause scheduled rerank jobs and hold customer comms until next check.
lee_runtime: enabling prefix caching for commonly seen prefixes to lower decode load. patch:
```
cache.enable_prefix=true
cache.whitelist=["/v1/embeddings"]
```
alex_oncall: 30m check: system stable, but Customer B still seeing intermittent 429s during their bulk windows. Proposed follow-up: offer temporary quota bump if they can spread load; otherwise schedule dedicated burst slot.
maya_prod: reaching out to Customer B with options now.
zoe_nextoncall: I'm taking the handoff at +45m. Summary: soft per-tenant caps applied, /v1/embeddings max_inflight reduced to 8, age-shed (6s) enabled, rerank disabled, prefix caching on. Metrics improved. Still watching Customer B. If any regression, escalate to infra for temporary capacity add.
alex_oncall: handoff ack. tagging runbook: /runbooks/runtime/backpressure.md — note applied changes under "emergency soft-shed" section.
zoe_nextoncall: will keep watch for 3 hours and coordinate with infra to provision burst capacity if required.
samir_support: leaving a note for customers: we offered a temporary quota adjustment + recommended staggered requests. :thumbsup:
alex_oncall: closing incident channel in 1h if no regression. :white_check_mark:
